delivery: Nix-managed Rust CLI; no daemon, TUI, or self-update lane

requirements.contract: Speech requests persist under XDG_STATE_HOME/agent-utils/tts/speech.jsonl, independent of PCM cache; old feed is copied once without deleting it.

Agent tool-result images, explicit kitty gallery additions/samples and local assistant image Markdown are copied with immutable provenance sidecars; user uploads and background preview frames are not implicitly archived.
Private atomic publication, bounded image size, checksum, safe agent paths, repeat-event idempotency and survival after source/session deletion.
Typed CLI/JSON/MCP reads share one domain core; config uses configurable-cli with managed symlink support.
Configured SSH hosts/usernames/ports/paths; fan-out isolates failures; tails reconnect from cursors without replaying delivered entries; Ctrl-C reaps child processes.
Bounded JSONL, history, image-list and transport reads; human output escapes terminal controls; read-only operations never alter source archives.
Independent ag subflake, root named package and aggregate, locked build; Collective config symlink and agent-utils pin updated without switch.

integration_notes.mcp_cli: Required; read-only list/history/config tools, finite results only. CLI follow is intentionally not an unending MCP call.
integration_notes.configurable_cli: Required; AG_CONFIG, XDG config, canonical YAML/schema/validation and symlink-preserving management.
integration_notes.updatable_cli: Not applicable to this Nix-only package; update the flake pin rather than overwriting a store binary.
integration_notes.feedback_cli: No automatic telemetry or remote error submission for this private transcript/image reader; bounded structured CLI/MCP errors and per-node tail status are local only.
integration_notes.ahp: Current structural bridge v1 only supports input providers. No unsupported attachment/resource capabilities advertised; image archiving remains independently functional.
